description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Cost 5 Tally

The Combine used to send a crew and three days. Then they started sending you.

Strike the ground, a structure, or the air where a structure used to be. Every creature and object in a 30-foot burst within 60 feet takes 20d10 bludgeoning damage, basic Reflex save against your Class DC, and the area becomes rubble and difficult terrain permanently. Buildings in the area fall. Spending Tally this way is not a Redline and causes no Slip, but you are fatigued afterwards until you next rest.

cinderfall.incomplete: A 30-foot burst within 60 feet, 20d10 bludgeoning, basic Reflex against Class DC, at an explicit Cost of 5 Tally. The AoE-burst-basic-save shape alone would ship unencoded (matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/exemplar/giant-felling-comet.json, rules: []), but the stated "Cost 5 Tally" is the action's actual activation gate, and Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
